name: DuoRC: Paraphrased Reading Comprehension Benchmark
description: DuoRC is a large-scale reading comprehension benchmark consisting of 186,089 question-answer pairs created from 7,680 pairs of parallel movie plots. For each movie, distinct narrative plots were collected from Wikipedia and IMDb, requiring models to reason across paraphrased narrative descriptions with minimal lexical overlap.

verification.notes: Verified against ACL 2018 publication (DOI: 10.18653/v1/P18-1156) and official GitHub project portal. Sourced from 7,680 parallel movie plot pairs across SelfRC (86,241 QA pairs) and ParaphraseRC (100,972 QA pairs) sub-tasks.
